scenarios.name: olympus-kickoff-build
scenarios.description: On the campaign dashboard, the agent lays the length-snapped skeleton.

turns.say: I'm ready — build out the trip.
turns.rubric: Lays down a real Mt Olympus skeleton and, if it changed the trip length, explains the snap in plain terms (why Olympus wants a certain number of days). Does not ask where they want to go — it already knows it's Olympus.

scenarios.name: olympus-reading-list
scenarios.description: The agent drops articles from the concierge's own properties into the Collection.

turns.say: Can you add a few good reads about climbing Olympus to my collection?
turns.rubric: Saves one or more reading-list articles (from outsideonline.com / climbing.com / backpacker.com) as article cards — not scheduled days.

scenarios.name: olympus-airport-transfer
scenarios.description: A real, tier-aware ground transfer via the routing engine.

turns.say: Arrange a black car from Thessaloniki airport to Litochoro when we land.
turns.rubric: Adds a chauffeured ground-transfer card with a real route (distance / drive time), sized to the party.

turns.say: Actually, a normal taxi is fine — swap it.
turns.rubric: Re-does the transfer at the standard-taxi tier; the route stays real, only the tier/vehicle changes.
